text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired — service=inference-gateway-prod region=eu-west1 metric=5xx_rate value=18.2% (threshold=5%) over 5m. Graph: https://metrics.redwood/inference-gateway/alerts/2172001234

pagerduty-bot: Incident RDW-5234 created and paged: sre-oncall escalation policy. Priority: P1. Link: https://pd.redwood/incident/RDW-5234

zoe (oncall): acked. I'm the primary — starting triage. Quick check: any recent deploys in the last 30m?

sam (sre): looking. No deploys in infra. Noticing a spike in backend 502s from the kv-cache-populator pool. Logs show repeated upstream reset.

zoe (oncall): copying logs now. Running quick probe to health endpoints for gateway backends.

sam (sre): tailing gateway logs — lots of "received reset from upstream" and 504 timeouts. Also seeing a rise in CPU on proxy containers.

ops-bot: Auto-scaling event: increased node pool size by +2 in eu-west1 at 2172001400 due to schedule.

zoe (oncall): trying to route a small percentage of traffic to fallback model-v1 (lower capacity) to reduce pressure. Enabling fallback route 5%.

kevin (eng-runtime): @zoe can you hold changes to routing? I want to check KV cache warmup — if cache miss storm, routing might not help. Pulling cache metrics.

maya (eng-platform): paging DBA to confirm no upstream DB flapping. Also notify customer success for possible impacted tenants.

sam (sre): quick commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
kubectl -n prod logs pod/inference-gateway-7f6b -c proxy --since=10m | grep -i "reset\|timeout" | tail -n 100
```

sam (sre): sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T01:02:11Z proxy[pid:2345] ERROR upstream reset by peer id=cache-pop-3 conn=10.12.4.7:443 path=/v1/generate
2026-03-14T01:02:12Z proxy[pid:2345] WARN request took 1803ms status=502
```

zoe (oncall): customer-impact check: three customers show increased 5xx in dashboards (acct-redacted-1, acct-redacted-8, acct-redacted-42) — CS notified.

kevin (eng-runtime): I see KV cache eviction spike ~00:59 — most caches dropped due to simultaneous restart of cache-populator pods. Likely root cause: rolling restart triggered by sidecar crashloop.

zoe (oncall): plan: 1) pin cache-populator to previous image 2) restart cache-populator with controlled concurrency 3) enable temporary circuit-breaker to reduce fanout to failing backends 4) rollback gateway proxy change if needed. Agree?

sam (sre): +1. I'll pin the pod and start controlled restart.

kevin (eng-runtime): doing a canary rollback of cache-populator to image sha: a1b2c3 -> executing:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/cache-populator cache-populator=registry.redwood/cache-populator:a1b2c3 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/cache-populator -w
```

ops-bot: Action logged by kevin at 2172001505: rollout started.

zoe (oncall): enabling circuit-breaker rule to drop new heavy multimodal jobs at edge to reduce backend QPS. Temporarily disable model-dispatch for non-critical routes. Command applied.

sam (sre): after pin + restart: backend 502 rate falling 5m avg => 6.8%. Still above alert threshold but trending down.

pagerduty-bot: RDW-5234 acknowledged by zoe.

kevin (eng-runtime): can confirm cache hitrate recovering from 12% -> 72% over 10m. Memory stable. Looks like the restart fixed the eviction storm.

maya (eng-platform): scaling note — increased dedicated pool for inference-gateway by +20% to absorb load at 2172001680.

zoe (oncall): customer impact update: errors reduced for two customers, acct-redacted-42 still elevated but on a downward trend. CS posted interim update.

sam (sre): disabling fallback route (5%) to restore normal routing now that cache warmed.

zoe (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Still monitoring for 30m. I'll hand off to kevin for post-incident follow-up and to draft a short RCA. @kevin please take postmortem owner?

kevin (eng-runtime): taking postmortem ownership. Preliminary root cause: cache-populator sidecar crashloop triggered mass cache eviction during rolling restart -> upstream resets -> proxy CPU spikes -> 5xx wave. Will include corrective actions: health-check hardening, restart-backoff tuning, and safer rollout gating for cache-populator.

zoe (oncall): thanks team. Adding notes to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/RDW-5234/notes. Will close pager if no regression. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident RDW-5234 status changed to mitigated at 2172001845.
